title: Honky Tonk Suite/6 BR/3600sqft, Walkto Broadway
description:
Walkable to Broadway from our 3600 sq ft 6th floor Suite at The Maddox, an historic Boutique Hotel. Ideal for bachelor/bachelorette gatherings, special occasions, corporate retreats, executive getaway or business meetings. Every member of your group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located suite. TPAC, Bridgestone Arena, Titans Stadium, The Gulch, and 2nd & Broadway are all within walking distance. The Library Liquor Store is right next to our Lobby entrance (as our guest

The space
Our beautifully furnished 3,595 sq feet suite with 6 bedrooms, 3 full baths (1 of the bathrooms has 3 private shower stalls), and one 1/2 bath. We have a built-in convection/
microwave oven, a refrigerator and freezer, separate ice maker, dishwasher, 2-burner induction stove top, an air fryer, crock pot, waffle maker, and toasters. You will be able to whip up the basics, and then some, in the kitchen.

Guest access
This suite is on the 6th floor and you and your guests will have the sole access to the bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen and game room. Your code will open the exterior building doors as well as your suite.

Other things to note
There is a downtown grocery store within walking distance or a Whole Foods and Publix, both a mile away.
